exposure: fertility-sparing surgery (conization/LEEP, radical trachelectomy) for early-stage cervical cancer
cohort: The study included 32 women with early-stage cervical cancer (12 stage IA1 and 20 stage IB1) who underwent conservative or fertility-sparing surgery in a tertiary medical center between 2004 and 2017.
finding: Patients with early-stage cervical cancer who undergo fertility-sparing surgery can achieve successful pregnancy and delivery, with a live birth rate of 73.3% among those who attempted pregnancy.
